cue_action_primary.input_scope: Controlled trial-level behavioral data, cross-fitted RL outputs, and canonical cue-window EEG features.

cue_encoding_primary.strict_outer_fold_definition: Same existing RL outer folds. RL targets for both train and test subjects are regenerated from that fold's train-only RL posterior.
cue_encoding_primary.primary_predictor_definition: Nominal cue-window EEG predictors only; no target-locked or response-locked EEG. Nominal pre-target labels do not establish strictly prospective temporal support after non-causal filtering.
cue_encoding_primary.baseline_definition: Task design + strictly lagged behavioral history from companion behavioral-computational study.
cue_encoding_primary.contrast_sign: Positive MSE gain = EEG lowers held-out standardized target MSE.
cue_encoding_primary.input_scope: Controlled trial-level behavioral data, cross-fitted RL outputs, and canonical cue-window EEG features.

note: Cue analyses use nominal cue-window features. Corrected participant-level RL–EEG inference uses Freedman–Lane residual permutation. Public results are aggregate; participant-level EEG and behavioral data are not distributed.

response_marker_qc.interpretation: Agreement with the nearest response marker in the imported event list; internal timing-consistency QC, not independent validation of behavioral RT accuracy.

cohort.selection: Adjusted BART top 20% and bottom 20% strata, with random selection from the extreme groups, following the published study logic; 20 participants per group in the present analysis.

eeg_preprocessing_provenance.note: No ICA step was applied to the EEG data used in the present analysis. The ICA step reported in the source publication pertains to that publication's preprocessing pipeline.
eeg_preprocessing_provenance.temporal_support: Recovered FIR and time-frequency pipelines use non-causal/zero-phase processing; cue windows are nominally pre-target, not proof of strictly leakage-free prospective information.

package_status: computational analyses and aggregate reporting frozen; publication metadata pending

response_monitoring_primary.rl_provenance: canonical nested/cross-fitted LATENTS only; embedded EEG-table RL columns ignored
response_monitoring_primary.association_status: Supportive individual-differences analysis; corrected Freedman–Lane results are the authoritative participant-level association inference.
response_monitoring_primary.rl_input: Cross-fitted M6 trial-level latents generated by shared/rl/nested_crossvalidated_latent_generation.py.
response_monitoring_primary.response_contrast_inference: Participant-level FA-minus-Go-hit performance-monitoring contrasts; 5,000 participant bootstraps, 10,000 sign-flip permutations, BH-FDR across the fixed six-signature family.
response_monitoring_primary.interpretation_constraint: FA-minus-Go-hit differs in both error status and NoGo/Go target context; not a pure error-specific contrast.

between_participant_rl_eeg_associations.permutation_method: Freedman-Lane residual permutation; residuals restricted within group strata when group_high is a nuisance covariate
between_participant_rl_eeg_associations.primary_fdr: BH across fixed 6 neural signatures x 3 canonical RL predictors
between_participant_rl_eeg_associations.diagnostics: predictor VIF >=5 or design condition number >=30 flagged for collinearity
between_participant_rl_eeg_associations.interpretation: supportive between-participant association, not independent confirmation, causal evidence, or trial-level neural implementation
